definition: a thing I own that reduces what I need and needs a company to keep working

settled:
My laser engraver is two things at once. It lets me fabricate a part I would otherwise have to buy, and it needs the maker's cloud to run at all, so they can switch it off from where they are.

Both sides count when I rank it. Counting only the first one flatters it, and counting only the second misses why I bought it.

I expect to meet more of this shape rather than less. A capability that arrives as a connected device brings the vendor in with it.

title: The Tool That Is Also A Dependency
